text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Naples-based U.S. Navy P-3 Orion aircraft made an emergency landing at Malta on Tuesday evening after being reportedly hit by lightning, which damaged its nose cone. No one was injured.
- Eleven local councils from tiny villages in southeast Malta have teamed up to propose restoration projects which could be partly funded through an Italian financial assistance programme.
- Three small bays in Malta have been reportedly contaminated by sewage outflows, without the health authorities issuing any warning.
